headline: Executive order bans bringing certain jadeite and rubies from Burma (Myanmar) into the United States.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Obama, bars certain imports of jadeite (a type of jade) and rubies that come from Burma, also called Myanmar. Based on the title alone, it limits what gem and jewelry products can legally enter the United States. The exact items covered and any exceptions are not described in the material provided.

who_it_affects.how: They may not bring in the covered Burmese jadeite and rubies.
Covered Burmese gems may be unavailable for sale in the United States.

who_it_affects.group: Gem miners and exporters in Burma
who_it_affects.how: They lose access to US buyers for the covered gems.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 6, 2013; no separate start date is given in the material provided.
